title: A Revolving Door Is Solving A Problem You Can't See

scenes.narration: A revolving door is slower than a normal door, more expensive to build, and much harder to carry anything through, and tall buildings keep installing them anyway.
scenes.note: Stack the objections honestly — the episode is stronger if the door genuinely looks worse first.

beats.action: Bill shuffles through a revolving door carrying an awkward box
three complaint labels stack up: SLOWER, EXPENSIVE, AWKWARD
the labels hold while tall buildings rise behind him
the door carries Bill round another slow quarter turn

scenes.narration: Warm air inside a tall building rises and escapes out of the top, and that pulls cold air in hard at street level.
scenes.note: THE invisible problem. A whole-building section — the scale of the airflow is the reveal.

beats.action: a tall building sections open from lobby to roof
warm air columns upward through the building and vents at the top
cold air rushes in hard at street level to replace it
the warm air column keeps rising through the building section
beats.sync: secondary action — closes a pacing gap

scenes.narration: On an ordinary door, that pressure difference turns the entrance into a wind tunnel and throws the heating out into the street.
scenes.note: The consequence, played for one small laugh — a hinged door as a wind tunnel.

beats.action: an ordinary hinged door opens at the lobby
air blasts through the opening; papers and hair fly
warm coral air pours out into the street and dissipates
the papers keep tumbling across the lobby floor

scenes.narration: A revolving door never actually opens.
scenes.note: The mechanism, from directly overhead. The seal is always closed — that is the whole trick.

beats.action: top-down view of the revolving door; four compartments rotate
the seal between inside and outside holds continuously as it turns

scenes.narration: Only the wedge of air in your compartment travels with you.
scenes.note: The small wedge versus the earlier blast. Contrast carries it. Hard cut.

beats.action: one small wedge of air shades in and rotates through with Bill
the lobby air stays completely still around him; hard cut
